notes: Verified feeds and APIs for discovery. A verified feed returned data on 2026-11-14. A documented API has public documentation but was not called. A sitemap-only source exposes no feed or API; use its sitemap for discovery. Respect each licence and robots.txt.

sources.name: Hugging Face Blog
sources.notes: The strongest single feed for open-model releases and methods. It includes lab posts, benchmark posts, and runtime releases.

sources.name: Hugging Face Papers
sources.notes: Returns paper metadata with thumbnails and identifiers. Use it for the research side of the journal.

sources.name: Hugging Face Daily Papers
sources.notes: Returns the daily paper list with submitter and engagement metadata.

sources.name: arXiv cs.CL
sources.notes: Computation and language. Pair it with cs.LG, cs.AI, cs.CV, and eess.AS for the other modalities.

sources.name: GitHub Releases
sources.notes: One feed per repository. Verified with llama.cpp and Transformers. Use it for runtimes and harnesses, not for model cards.

sources.name: Artificial Analysis Data API
sources.limits: Free tier about 100 requests per day
sources.license: Internal use only; no redistribution. Attribution to artificialanalysis.ai is required.
sources.notes: Use it for context only, never as openness evidence. Do not republish the raw rows. Store a link and a derived note.

sources.name: OpenRouter Models
sources.notes: Public model catalogue with pricing and free variants. It is a serving source, not an openness source.

sources.name: Simplifying AI RSS
sources.notes: The site links this beehiiv feed, but the host does not resolve from this network. Fall back to the sitemap.

sources.name: Simplifying AI Sitemap
sources.notes: Carries lastmod dates. It is a discovery source for the media account, not a model source.

sources.name: LLM Stats Sitemap
sources.notes: No feed. The robots file disallows /api/, so do not scrape or call the internal API. The sitemap is an index of model, provider, organisation, benchmark, and comparison pages.

sources.name: Artificial Analysis Sitemap
sources.notes: Contains lastmod dates for 146 entries. Use it to detect new model and comparison pages.

sources.name: Arena Sitemap
sources.notes: No feed and no public API. It is a leaderboard and evaluation surface.

sources.name: BigCode Sitemap
sources.notes: No feed. The lastmod dates are from 2020, so prefer GitHub releases and Hugging Face for change detection.

sources.name: Unsloth Sitemap
sources.notes: No feed. The lastmod dates are current, so the sitemap is a usable change surface.

sources.name: Arena
sources.notes: A worthwhile leaderboard aggregator, but Cloudflare blocks automated reads and the sitemap has leaderboard pages, not per-model pages. Link it as a general source; it adds no syndication points until a verifiable snapshot is available.
